chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Choose for your seed, for the maternal uncle is one of the two close associates.'

key_terms.الضَّجِيعَيْنِ: the two close associates/relatives who raise the child

ai.seo_question: Why is the maternal uncle important in choosing a wife according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) advises prospective parents to 'choose for your seed' by evaluating the maternal uncle (*al-khal*), who is described as one of the two primary caregivers (*al-daji'*) alongside the father. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on maternal lineage and the uncle's role in nurturing the child's character, making his moral standing a crucial criterion for marital selection to ensure the offspring's well-being.
